svg.title: LEONARD E. MOORE — latest RSS headlines

g.text: Google takes Dreambeans to India in bid to bring AI-generated personal stories to the masses ◆ Apple may try to increase revenue by doing…something with third-party AI apps ◆ Ukraine’s new pocket-sized gadget turns Russian drones’ cameras against them ◆ Y Combinator’s Garry Tan uses AI agents so much, he spends up to $200K a year on tokens ◆ Hinge tests a cheaper plan as users become more fed up paying for dating apps ◆ Apple says it’s ‘hard to predict’ when iPhone Duo constraints will improve ◆
